d:
Get ready to groove to “Yeshanagula” the high-energy dance track from The Paradise, starring Nani and Keerthy Suresh. Featuring an electrifying beat, powerful rhythm, and energetic vibes. Directed by Srikanth Odela. Music composed by Anirudh Ravichander.
Song Credits:
Song Title: Yeshanagula
Album / Movie: The Paradise
Composed by: Anirudh Ravichander
Lyrics by: Kasarla Shyam
(Source : Palamooru Folk)
Vocals by: Prabha Bangarigalla, Addula Jangireddy
